narrative.intro: Ram System Gmbh has $487M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Ram System Gmbh has won 8 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $60.9M. Ram System Gmbh obligations are up 10.5% year over year. Historical obligations show variation across recent fiscal years: FY21 totaled $136M, FY22 totaled $6M, FY23 totaled $680M, FY24 totaled $11.9M, and FY25 totaled $441M. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the leading market for Ram System Gmbh in FY2026 to date with $487M in obligations. The page note clarifies that figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This snapshot presents Ram System Gmbh as concentrated in a single large NAICS market for the current fiscal year while showing the company’s year-to-year volatility in obligations.
